messages:
Mia (Finance): Heads up — we received a chargeback (DB-8492) for txn txn_1034. Cardholder claims unauthorized. Network reason: "fraudulent". Merchant m-88 is pushing back. Can payments collect evidence?
Sam (Payments): On it. Mia, can you paste the payment metadata and any merchant-provided receipts/webhook payloads?
Mia (Finance): Pasting what we have from payments/merchant portal:
```json
{
  "tx_id": "txn_1034",
  "amount": "432.50",
  "currency": "USD",
  "card_last4": "4242",
  "merchant_id": "m-88",
  "auth_method": "network_token",
  "avs": "A",
  "cvv_check": "pass",
  "ip": "203.0.113.55",
  "device_id": "dev-77",
  "email": "cust.jane@example.com",
  "created": "2024-09-12T14:22:18Z"
}
```
Sam (Payments): Thanks. Merchant dashboard shows consumer name as "J. Smith" on delivery proof and billing name "Jane Smith". Merchant says they used their tokenization layer (network tokenization) — looks like token not generated by us.
Ellie (Risk Ops): Flagging: same network token (token_9x...) or same device_id dev-77 used across 3 different merchants in 48h (m-20, m-88, m-101). Velocity + cross-merchant reuse -> possible card-on-file token replay. Putting hold on settlement for m-88 for now. :eyes: @Sam
Frank (Support): Customer says they never ordered and wants refund. Logged support convo: short transcript attached in merchant portal screenshot. Customer IP in our logs earlier shows 203.0.113.55 which geo-resolves to a different state than shipping address.
finance-bot: New chargeback case DB-8492 created and assigned to team_payments. Case link: https://internal.redwood/cases/DB-8492
Sam (Payments): I'll fetch gateway auth trace, 3DS result, and merchant webhook delivery logs. Also requesting signed delivery receipt and courier tracking from merchant (they claim signature J. Smith). ETA ~2h.
Ellie (Risk Ops): Also pull device fingerprinting payload for dev-77 and check whether tokenization partner used merchant-supplied PAN or tokenized on client. If partner used merchant-supplied PAN, that increases merchant liability.
Mia (Finance): If we can produce: 1) successful 3DS auth OR 2) matching billing email + IP+AVS+signature, we fight. If not — advise merchant to accept and refund to avoid chargeback fees + merchant reputation hit.
Sam (Payments): Quick check: 3DS authenticated? Gateway shows 'ARes: Y' and ECI=05, but ACS response was frictionless. Will attach screencap.
Frank (Support): Support will freeze the customer's invoice/ticket note and offer a provisional refund if payments recommends.
Ellie (Risk Ops): Also recommend adding temporary risk flag to merchant m-88 for tokenization review — escalate to compliance if tokenization partner isn't PCI scoped properly.
Mia (Finance): Good. Sam please cc me on evidence package. If merchant doesn't provide signed proof + consistent geo & device signals, we'll mark chargeback as customer-unauthorized and absorb/route accordingly.
Sam (Payments): Will do. Starting evidence pull now — posting updates in this thread.
Frank (Support): FYI merchant co-billing_contact is merchant-ops@vendorcorp.com — pinging them for delivery docs.
Mia (Finance): Thanks all. If we get a clear merchant-signed POD and matching billing name, we fight. If we see token reuse across merchants with no merchant-level CVV/PAN handling, escalate.
Sam (Payments): Update: merchant supplied POD pdf (signature J. Smith) and courier tracking shows delivery to billing address on 2024-09-13. But device fingerprint shows device_id dev-77 flagged in other disputes. Uploading docs to case.
Ellie (Risk Ops): Based on combined signals I'm leaning toward partial liability shift to merchant tokenization partner. Recommend we prepare a representment packet arguing merchant had delivery but tokenization controls were lax.
Mia (Finance): Ok proceed with representment draft. Keep finance-bot updated and add all docs to DB-8492. If network forces chargeback, log cost and mark merchant remediation checklist required.
finance-bot: Evidence uploaded to case DB-8492: 6 files.
Sam (Payments): Done. Closing loop — I'll ping when representment submitted.
Mia (Finance): Great — thanks everyone.
